The successful candidate should ideally have exposure to:
VoIP / IPPBX: Yeastar, 3CX, Bicom, IPECS, IP Voice
Connectivity: Broadband, Mobile Broadband, Leased Lines
Networking: Routers, Switches, Wi-Fi, LAN
Hardware: Yealink, DECT, Headsets
Support: Fault Management, SLA Management, Outage Support, Remote Diagnostics

You are a technically minded troubleshooter who enjoys diagnosing telecoms, voice and connectivity faults rather than providing general desktop support.
You work logically, communicate confidently with customers and are comfortable investigating issues across VoIP platforms, internet connections, routers, Wi-Fi, switches and telecoms hardware until the root cause is identified and resolved.

Job Title: Senior Education Specialist (LSPID): Education Social Support Services
Job Description:
Requirements
Applicants must be in possession of a recognised 3- or 4-year qualification which includes a professional teacher qualification. They should be registered with the South African Council of Educators (SACE) as professional educator and have 5 years’ experience in the educational field. The incumbent must have in-depth knowledge and understanding of education legislation and policies.
The incumbent must be able to promote inclusive education which includes promoting access to quality public funded education for learners with disability. They should have experience in working as part of a team and collaborating with stakeholders. They should be able to take initiatives, work under pressure and problem-solve if and when necessary. Experience in co-ordinating education and other support for learners with disabilities will be an added advantage.
The incumbent will function as part of the District-based Support Team with the specific responsibility of providing transversal outreach services to care centres and special schools that include learners with severe to profound intellectual disability (LSPID). The job involves travelling and therefore a valid driver’s licence is a requirement. The applicant must have advanced computer skills.
Duties
As a member of the transversal team, the incumbent will collaborate with team members in the provision of education support to designated schools and care centres on an itinerant basis.
Support to be provided will include: Assessment of LSPID enrolled in the schools/ care centres; provision of relevant support to learners and families; monitoring and reporting on these learners’ progress; training caregivers on the learning programme for LSPID; monitoring and reporting caregivers’ implementation of the learning programme for LSPID;
training and supporting teachers on learning programme for LSPID; monitoring and reporting on the implementation of the learning programme in designated schools and care centres; advocating for access to quality public funded education for LSPID and carrying out administrative functions related to the support provided including placement of out of school children in schools.
The incumbent may also be required to provide support to other learners in the community as and when needed.

Job Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a dynamic Brand Manager to drive sales growth and elevate the brand image of Dr Reddy's in the country's branded markets. Your role will involve developing and implementing short and long-term strategies, including product and digital initiatives, based on market research insights and in collaboration with key opinion leaders.
This position requires effective management of marketing budgets, adherence to positioning strategies, and compliance with country regulations to achieve objectives of increasing market share and brand performance.
Roles & Responsibilities
You will be responsible for sizing the opportunity of micro segments, evaluating and creating engagement plans, building Customer Decision Journeys, identifying and prioritizing Leverage points, establishing market share and prescription objectives, developing detailed Brand and budget plans, understanding and utilizing channels and tools influencing the consumer funnel, tracking promotion trends, building Omni-channel promotion strategies, creating specialized content, obtaining approval from Marketing Manager, and taking corrective actions if necessary.
You will be responsible for establishing promotion strategies, deciding on promotional materials and key messages, creating various promotional tools, collaborating with art designers, testing brand materials, working with creative agencies, coordinating planning of articles, managing the annual budget, ensuring proper P&L management, and reviewing final art for materials to ensure compliance with campaign guidelines.
You will be responsible for implementing and monitoring action plans, conducting Root Cause Analysis for non-compliance with KPIs (Key Performance Indicators), attending sales review meetings, collecting feedback for campaign adjustments, gathering competitive intelligence, and ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards in marketing activities independently. You will also be expected to structure and communicate ideas clearly, review product positioning, and adjust action plans in a timely manner.
You will be responsible for engaging with Key Opinion Leaders (KOL) to identify unmet needs, analysing market and competitor data, and preparing business cases based on market trends.
You will also be responsible for defining long-term portfolio goals and strategies, developing algorithms for brand portfolio success, and creating financial forecasts.
You will be responsible for understanding and applying effective digital communication principles, utilizing diverse digital channels and tools to plan and promote, while tracking the latest trends and performance indicators to evaluate digital marketing campaigns.
You will be responsible for developing and refining a multi-channel promotion strategy, tailoring specialized content for diverse target audiences and leveraging insights to adapt campaigns accordingly.
You will stay updated on e-commerce trends, analyse web KPIs, optimize promotional tools, and assess the effectiveness of digital strategies through regular evaluation and adjustment.
You will be responsible for contributing to conceptualizing and planning Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE), offering support to SFE specialists and teams, monitoring reports for brand concerns, discussing actions with sales leaders, and providing input for Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to address challenges in marketing plan execution and drive action plans for regions falling short of KPIs.
You will be responsible for collaborating with external stakeholders to align on company goals, planning activities with scientific organizations, coordkol
inating specialized press articles, and effectively communicating ideas to management.
You will be responsible for establishing collaboration plans with KOLs, developing brand strategies, measuring action plan effectiveness, maintaining trust in business interactions, engaging with medical experts for brand planning, considering stakeholder needs, adhering to legal regulations, and staying updated on medical trends.
You will be responsible for effectively communicating brand values to KOLs, managing contracts, addressing inquiries from KOLs, and planning their participation in events.
You will plan and oversee scientific research aligned with brand strategy, choose research parameters, and ensure proper execution for future utilization.
You will be responsible for preparing and updating presentations and training materials for Sales Force (SF) cycle meetings, ensuring alignment with the company's strategy and objectives.
You will conduct training sessions, address objections, and organize educational plans with KOLs to enhance the marketing knowledge of the Sales Force.
You will proactively initiate meetings with the Training Department to develop strategic guidelines and continually assess SF training needs for effective performance improvement.
You will be responsible for demonstrating a proactive approach to seizing market opportunities, including exploring new segments and geographies, leading to a multi-year growth plan, outpacing competitors, and enhancing brand leadership.
You will be responsible for ensuring meticulous planning and execution of marketing activities, including brand campaigns, events, and new product launches, while remaining adaptable and responsive to feedback, ensuring timely delivery and effective countermeasures for non-achievement.
You will be responsible for establishing a strong rapport with sales teams, inspiring them to execute marketing objectives effectively, while also influencing management to invest in the brand and ensuring the necessary support for generating demand in the market.
You will be responsible for utilizing insight-driven, cost-effective marketing campaigns tailored to address customer pain points and leverage customer segmentation approaches, while prioritizing speed and innovation in new product launches and fostering external partnerships to go beyond the pill and enhance patient services.
You will be responsible for ensuring month-over-month sales and profitability targets are met, conducting regular reviews with the sales team to identify areas for improvement, analysing key performance indicators, and conducting A/B testing to optimize communication effectiveness for improved conversions.
You will be responsible for utilising analytical skills to identify growth sources, applying therapy knowledge to differentiate brand communication, executing with optimal budget utilization, and gathering stakeholder feedback for execution evaluation.
To report product complaints (adverse events & product technical complaints) and medical information queries for all DRL products as per internal processes.

Minimum work experience: 2+ years in BM (Brand Management) role with experience into any of CNS/ Gastro specialties / CVD portfolios
Skills & attributes:
Business acumen, advanced capabilities of marketing and digital tools.
Knowledge of Marketing code and Act 101 with regards to advertising of medicines.
Ability to interpret market data and gain marketing insights from various resources.
Ability to lead cross-functional projects.
Leadership skills and a team worker.
Good analytical, presentation and negotiation skills.
Understanding how to use channels and tools influencing consumer funnel.
Understanding of the principles of effective communication in the Digital space.
Understanding of KPIs of Digital tools (clicks, impressions, views)
Knowledge of therapy, market and competitors to create differentiated brand communication.
Experience in launching an originator drug (not mandatory)

Role Purpose:
To oversee and coordinate all mine dewatering activities to ensure effective water management, safe pit operations and uninterrupted mining production. The role is responsible for the installation, operation, inspection and maintenance coordination of pumps, pipelines and associated dewatering infrastructure to minimise water accumulation, prevent flooding and maintain operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities:
Dewatering Operations
Supervise daily dewatering activities across the open-cast mining operation.
Monitor pit water levels, groundwater inflows, rainfall and potential flooding risks.
Ensure that pumps, pipelines, hoses and associated equipment operate efficiently.
Coordinate the installation, relocation and commissioning of pumps as mining activities progress.
Ensure sufficient pumping capacity and standby equipment are available.
Monitor discharge points and water management infrastructure in accordance with site procedures and applicable environmental requirements.
Safety, Health and Environmental Compliance
Ensure compliance with the Mine Health and Safety Act (MHSA), mine standards and relevant safety procedures.
Conduct workplace inspections, risk assessments and pre-task safety briefings.
Identify and address hazards associated with water accumulation, electrical equipment, pipelines and pump installations.
Investigate incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions, implementing corrective actions.
Ensure that water discharge and handling comply with applicable environmental authorisations and site requirements.
Maintenance and Equipment Management
Coordinate preventive maintenance and repairs of dewatering equipment.
Monitor pump performance, equipment availability and breakdown trends.
Liaise with engineering and maintenance teams to resolve technical problems.
Ensure proper housekeeping and the safe handling, storage and use of equipment.
Maintain accurate records of equipment inspections, maintenance activities and operational performance.
Production and Operational Support
Work closely with mining, engineering and production teams to align dewatering activities with mining plans.
Identify potential water-related production delays and implement proactive mitigation measures.
Ensure that mining areas, haul roads, working benches and pit access routes are managed to minimise water-related operational risks.
Develop and implement contingency plans for heavy rainfall, pump failure and unexpected water inflows.
Cost and Resource Management
Monitor dewatering-related expenditure, including energy, diesel, equipment hire, maintenance and consumables.
Identify opportunities to improve pumping efficiency and reduce operational costs.
Manage the effective utilisation of personnel, equipment and contractors.
Report on operational performance, resource utilisation and budget variances.
Team Supervision and Reporting
Supervise pump operators, dewatering personnel and relevant contractors.
Allocate duties, monitor performance and ensure adequate shift coverage.
Provide on-the-job training and reinforce safe working practices.
Maintain accurate daily reports on water levels, pump operating hours, breakdowns, maintenance and dewatering performance.
Escalate operational risks and equipment failures to management promptly.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Grade 12 / Matric.
Relevant technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mining Engineering or a related field will be advantageous.
Relevant training in pump operation, water management, maintenance or dewatering systems will be beneficial.
Valid driver's licence.
EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Previous supervisory experience in an open-cast mining operation, preferably coal mining.
Practical experience with industrial pumps, pipelines, hoses and dewatering equipment.
Experience coordinating maintenance, breakdowns and equipment installations.
Experience managing teams, contractors and operational resources.

Operator Training & Development: Conduct and coordinate SOP, compliance, operational and Mining Health & Safety training. Provide ongoing coaching, refresher training, and practical workplace development for Operators

Job Description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
Traditional insurers make product decisions. Digital businesses make customer decisions. NMSIS must do both. Every day we determine which customers should receive which offer, which products create the greatest long-term value, which channels should engage them, how to prevent lapses, optimise pricing, improve claims outcomes and maximise profitability.
The Head: Decision Intelligence will build the capability that turns data into commercial decisions — improving growth, customer outcomes and profitability across the business. As NMSIS evolves into a platform orchestrator within the MultiChoice ecosystem, this role is being created to give the business dedicated, accountable ownership of enterprise-wide decision intelligence, lead optimisation, predictive analytics and customer lifetime value management.
This is not a reporting role, a traditional analytics role or a pure data science role. It sits where business strategy, insurance, customer behaviour, artificial intelligence and advanced analytics intersect. You will build the commercial operating system powering Insurance, Customer Intelligence, Lead Optimisation, Pricing Feedback Loops, Behavioural Decisioning, Next Best Action, Customer Lifetime Value Optimisation, Growth Intelligence, Portfolio Performance and Executive Decision Support — acting as the central integration point between NMSIS, MultiChoice CII, Sanlam BI & Data Engineering, Santam and TrueSouth Actuaries
QUALIFICATIONS
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science or a related quantitative discipline (essential).
Postgraduate qualification in a quantitative or technical discipline (advantageous).
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
5–8 years' experience in analytics, data science or data engineering within a commercial or financial services environment.
Hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python (or R), with demonstrated experience designing and deploying propensity or segmentation models in a production environment.
Experience governing multi-partner data delivery relationships, including SLA management, data quality standards and governance frameworks.
A track record of translating complex analytical outputs into commercially actionable decisions and senior-level intelligence reporting.
Ability to operate fluently across both technical teams (data engineers, data scientists) and business stakeholders (EXCO, distribution, operations) simultaneously.
Experience within financial services, insurance, banking, telecommunications, retail, digital platforms, consulting or customer intelligence; experience leading multidisciplinary business and technology teams is advantageous.
Advantageous:
Insurance or embedded financial services experience, with an understanding of underwriting, pricing and portfolio economics.
Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI or equivalent cloud-based analytics and data warehousing platforms.
Exposure to decisioning platforms, rules engines or campaign orchestration tooling.
Familiarity with insurance economics: VNB, CLV, persistency, CAC payback and contribution margin.
POPIA, FAIS or equivalent regulatory data compliance experience in a South African context.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Key Responsibilities:
Data Foundation & Engineering
Own the integrated data model across all relevant domains — DStv Subscriber ID, Insurance Policy ID, CRM Customer Number, Payments Account ID, and Identity Number — linked via a unified customer identity layer that connects subscriber, lead, policy, claims, billing, rewards and behavioural signals.
Govern MultiChoice/CII data delivery: SLA standards, field definitions, delivery frequency, quality thresholds and escalation paths, driving the roadmap from monthly batch delivery toward event-triggered data flows as infrastructure matures.
Lead data engineering into Sanlam: governed, versioned, lineage-tracked analytical datasets that are fit for decisioning, not only fit for reporting.
Maintain a structured data gap register with commercial impact quantification, identifying precisely where deficiencies are constraining model quality, automation or commercial optimisation.
Ensure POPIA compliance and all data sharing agreement obligations with MultiChoice are embedded in every data flow and processing activity.
Models & Advanced Analytics
Direct and govern the full model suite in partnership with CII, Sanlam Data Science and TrueSouth, including: Lead Quality Index (LQI) — multi-factor scoring incorporating economic proxies, lapse risk, claims probability and behavioural signals, moving beyond contactability-only scoring; cross-sell propensity models — product-specific acquisition propensity per product house (e.g. Entertainment Plus, Funeral Plus, Life Plus, Home, Home Contents, Device upgrade loans), enriched with LQI to prevent volume-over-quality lead acceptance; NTU prediction — identifying pre-sale signals that predict non-conversion, enabling intervention before commitment; lapse and persistency models — early duration (M1–M3) lapse prediction, affordability vulnerability scoring and behaviour-based retention triggers; CLV and CAC optimisation — multi-product customer lifetime value accounting for cross-sell probability, claims experience, reward cost and contribution margin, with CAC payback modelling by channel and segment; and claims risk and pricing feedback — frequency and severity prediction, fraud signal detection, repair-vs-replace optimisation, and variance monitoring against pricing assumptions.
Govern model performance standards: documentation, drift monitoring, recalibration triggers, champion/challenger frameworks and model risk governance aligned to Sanlam Group standards.
Ensure all models are grounded in insurance economics — VNB, persistency, contribution margin, capital efficiency — and remain aligned to customer fairness and FSCA conduct expectations.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Decisioning & Lead Intelligence
Design and operationalise the lead segmentation and routing framework: channelling each lead to the right product house, sales channel and offer configuration based on LQI score, propensity, channel economics and cross-sell potential — not raw contactability or volume.
Ensure lead allocation logic balances conversion probability, persistency probability, product margin, channel economics (CAC by channel) and cross-sell potential simultaneously, not any single metric in isolation.
Build closed-loop feedback between lead outcomes (conversion, early lapse, NTU, claims) and upstream scoring, enabling continuous improvement in lead quality without requiring manual recalibration cycles.
Design structured decisioning frameworks for acquisition, retention and cross-sell, translating model outputs into executable business rules, scoring logic and decision playbooks that BPO teams, campaign managers and distribution leads can act on directly.
Drive the evolution from human-led toward rules-driven, model-assisted and AI-augmented execution, enabling the organisation to operate at scale despite constrained headcount.
Support scenario and trade-off analysis: conversion vs persistency; CAC vs CLV thresholds; channel investment allocation; pricing adequacy vs growth rate.
Execution, Governance & Commercial Intelligence
Integrate model outputs into campaign targeting systems, BPO dialling and scripting logic, digital campaign tools and retention workflow engines, working in close partnership with the CGO and COO teams.
Produce EXCO-grade commercial intelligence: CLV by segment, CAC payback by channel and product, channel economics scorecards, lapse cohort analysis, product contribution margin reports and VNB attribution by segment and channel.
Establish and govern a test-and-learn architecture: control group methodology, A/B testing for decisioning variants, campaign uplift measurement and decision performance tracking against defined OKRs and enterprise scorecard metrics.
Own DI decision governance, ensuring all production models and decisioning rules are transparent, explainable, documented and aligned to regulatory, conduct and risk appetite guardrails; identify and escalate where decisions are destroying economic value or weakening capital efficiency.
Chair the NMSIS/MultiChoice (CII) DI operating rhythm, covering data foundation, engineering, model and advanced analytics, decisioning and lead intelligence, model performance reviews, data quality reviews and use case backlog management.
Own the DI maturity roadmap — a structured, phased progression from the current Level 2 (Siloed) toward Level 4 (Ecosystem Intelligence) across data foundation, integration, product reporting, growth analytics and AI-assisted decisioning.
Maintain reusable decision assets that are version-controlled and actively used — documented rules, scoring logic, prioritisation frameworks and performance feedback loops — building decisioning as a repeatable organisational capability, not an individual dependency.
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
Strong commercial acumen and analytical thinking.
Customer decisioning expertise and executive communication skills.
Stakeholder management capability across technical and business audiences.
Intellectual curiosity, technical confidence and a structured, outcomes-driven approach to problem-solving.
A passion for building new capabilities from the ground up.

Participate as a professional member of the multi-disciplinary team in evaluating, developing and implementing health care plans and treatment regime.

Prepare day / night shift documentation that reflects patient status, patient / staff ratio and problems
Communicate with the unit manager, so that he / she is informed of activities and problems
Perform any related tasks as requested.
Provide input and standards in formulating patient care policy and procedures in the hospital
To ensure the provision of a safe, clean and secure environment for patients, staff and visitors.

Evaluate, set standards and monitor safe utilization of supplies and equipment

Actively participate as a member of a team to achieve goals

Co-operate with the Clinical Facilitators in planning, implementing mentoring and evaluation of learning experiences / opportunities for nursing staff / students
Provide for the ongoing review, practice and in-service training of emergency procedures
Actively participate in in-service training and orientation of new staff in the unit
Advise and inform staff on current and revised policies and procedures
Allocate staff members in a manner that promotes optimal use of staff to provide appropriate nursing care for the individual patient regarding his / her needs and specialised skills needed by the nursing staff member through proper clinical judgement.
Adjust staff levels to provide for acuity level needs
Active involvement in own professional development to maintain a satisfactory level of skill and knowledge
Keep up to date with Netcare’s evolving policies and procedures
Work effectively and co-operatively with others to establish and maintain good working relationships that are mutually beneficial.
Develop collaborative relationships to help accomplish work goal

Job Description:
Purpose of Job
To provide strategic company secretarial and governance support to an allocated portfolio of South African and international subsidiaries, joint ventures and governance structures within the Mining, Energy and International Subsidiaries portfolio. The role is responsible for ensuring effective governance practices, compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, implementation of Sasol governance standards, and the efficient functioning of boards and committees. The role serves as a trusted governance adviser to directors, management and stakeholders and contributes to the enhancement of governance effectiveness across the Group's subsidiary portfolio.
Key Accountabilities
Subsidiary Governance Leadership
Lead the delivery of company secretarial and governance services for an allocated portfolio of South African and international subsidiaries, joint ventures and governance structures.
Ensure the consistent application of Sasol governance frameworks, policies, standards and delegated authority structures.
Advise directors and management on governance, fiduciary duties, statutory obligations and governance best practice.
Support sound decision-making through the provision of timely governance advice and recommendations.
Maintain an accurate understanding of governance developments affecting the allocated portfolio.
Board and Committee Governance
Act as secretary to allocated boards and committees.
Manage annual board and committee workplans and meeting calendars.
Coordinate the preparation and quality review of agendas, meeting packs, resolutions and governance documentation.
Attend meetings and ensure the accurate recording of proceedings, decisions and action items.
Monitor implementation of board and committee resolutions and agreed actions.
Support director induction, governance education and ongoing board development initiatives.
Promote governance best practice and continuous improvement in governance processes
International Subsidiary Governance
Coordinate governance activities across multiple jurisdictions through engagement with local directors, service providers and external legal advisers.
Monitor compliance with local statutory requirements and regulatory obligations applicable to foreign entities.
Ensure that international entities remain aligned with Sasol governance standards and reporting requirements.
Oversee governance activities performed by external company secretarial service providers and monitor performance against agreed service standards.
Escalate material governance, compliance or regulatory matters where appropriate.
Governance Assurance and Risk Management
Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of subsidiary governance frameworks.
Apply risk-based governance principles to determine appropriate governance oversight for entities within the portfolio.
Contribute to governance assurance activities and governance maturity assessments across subsidiaries.
Identify governance risks, compliance risks and emerging regulatory developments and recommend mitigation actions.
Monitor and report on governance compliance and governance effectiveness within the allocated portfolio.
Corporate Transactions and Structural Governance
Support mergers, acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, financings and other corporate actions from a governance and statutory compliance perspective.
Facilitate the establishment, amendment and closure of legal entities in accordance with applicable legal and governance requirements.
Lead governance aspects of entity rationalisation, deregistration and liquidation projects.
Coordinate governance approvals, resolutions and filings associated with corporate transactions
Oversight of Outsourced Governance and Trust Administration Services
Manage relationships with external governance and trust administration service providers.
Monitor service delivery and compliance with contractual and governance requirements.
Maintain oversight of trust governance structures administered by external service providers.
Keep abreast of developments, governance matters and emerging risks relating to trust structures within the portfolio.
Coordinate reporting, governance reviews and escalation of significant matters impacting outsourced governance arrangements
Stakeholder Management
Build and maintain effective relationships with directors, executives, legal teams, finance teams, external advisers and regulators.
Serve as a primary point of contact for governance matters across the allocated portfolio.
Facilitate effective communication between boards, committees, management and external stakeholders.
Influence and support a culture of ethical leadership and sound governance practices.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and strengthen governance processes.
Promote the adoption of technology and digital governance solutions to enhance governance effectiveness.
Contribute to governance transformation initiatives and strategic projects within Company Secretarial Services.
Share governance knowledge and best practices across the function.

Minimum
Bachelor's Degree in Law, Commerce, Corporate Governance or a related field.
Relevant postgraduate qualification.
Preferred
Chartered Governance Professional (CGISA/CGI) qualification.
Postgraduate qualification in Corporate Law, Governance or Business Administration

12 years' experience in company secretarial, corporate governance, legal or related roles.
Significant experience supporting boards and committees.
Experience in corporate governance, statutory compliance and regulatory affairs.

Corporate Governance – King V
Companies Act and Corporate Law
Regulatory Compliance
Board and Committee Governance
Governance Assurance and Risk Management
Corporate Transactions
Drafting and Minute Taking

Strategic Thinking
Influencing and Advisory Skills
Stakeholder Management
Commercial Awareness

Company Details: The formulation of South Africas Housing Policy commenced prior to the democratic elections, with the formation of the National Housing Forum. This forum was a multi-party non-governmental negotiating body comprising 19 members from business, the community, government, development organisations a...read morend political parties outside the government at the time. At these negotiations the foundation for the new government's Housing policy were developed and agreed to. This culminated in the achievement of the broad housing sector convention also referred to as the Housing Accord that concluded into the White Paper on Housing 1994 The Government of National Unity in 1994 made use of these negotiations and investigations when it formulated South Africas National Housing Policy. In October 1994 a National Housing Accord was signed by a range of stakeholders representing the homeless, government, communities and civil society, the financial sector, emerging contractors, the established construction industry, building material suppliers, employers, developers and the international community. This accord set down the beginning of the common vision that forms the essence of South Africas National Housing Policy. The National Housing Accord was soon followed by the Housing White Paper which was promulgated in December 1994. The White Paper sets out the framework for the National Housing Policy. Sanlam Fintech x is a newly established digital first business unit within the Sanlam Group on a mission to democratize financial advice and solutions for everyone across the African continent. We exist to pioneer inclusive financial confidence helping people build strong foundations to bridge the gap in generational wealth. Our culture is that of agility and constant deployment, we believe in learning fast, learning cheap and learning forward. Our aim is to provide a work environment where knowledge workers can accelerate the development of their ideas and bring innovation to market, at the same time provide compelling career and development proposition that will enable them to realize their dreams.
Sanlam Fintech x is looking for a Product Manager to join the central Digital Product function, reporting to a Head of Product. This role will own a meaningful part of the end-to-end digital customer journey, from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, optimisation and ongoing performance management. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, finance, risk, compliance and information security stakeholders to deliver customer and business value in a regulated financial services environment. This is a senior individual contributor role with strong influence across teams. It is not a people management role, but it does require leadership, sound judgement, stakeholder management and the ability to coach and support less experienced product managers where needed. The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with commercial awareness, customer empathy, delivery discipline and the ability to make high-quality decisions using evidence, context and clear trade-offs
What will you do?
As a Product Manager, you will:
Own product strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and execution for your assigned product domain or customer journey.
Define clear product problems, opportunities, outcomes and success metrics aligned to business and customer goals.
Partner with stakeholders across business units and central teams, including technology, design, data, marketing, finance, risk, compliance and information security.
Drive product discovery by using customer research, behavioural data, analytics, market insight and business context to identify opportunities and validate ideas.
Translate strategy into a well-prioritised product backlog that balances customer value, business value, technical feasibility and regulatory considerations.
Work closely with a Tech Lead and a cross-functional team to build, test, release and improve digital products and features.
Lead product decision-making across the product lifecycle, including trade-offs on scope, sequencing, timing and investment.
Monitor product performance using input, output and outcome metrics, and use those insights to drive continuous improvement.
Ensure that non-functional requirements such as security, compliance, auditability, operational resilience and customer data considerations are incorporated into product decisions.
Communicate product direction, priorities, progress, risks and decisions clearly to stakeholders at different levels of the organisation. • Contribute to strong product practices within Sanlam Fintech, including mentoring and coaching less experienced product managers where appropriate.
Qualification and Experience
5+ years' product management experience, with at least 2 years on developer-facing or platform products (internal platforms, dev tooling, APIs, data/ML platforms) in a modern cloud context.
Hands-on familiarity with AI coding agents and LLM-based products, shipped with them, or built on them, and you have a point of view on evals, cost and trust.
Comfortable working with autonomous, high-performing engineering teams and with security/compliance stakeholders (data residency, POPIA, RBAC, audit).
Experience defining and tracking product metrics and SLOs; exposure to budget and cost-of-compute thinking is a plus.
What will make you successful in this role?
In this role, success will typically include:
Delivering product or feature outcomes that improve meaningful customer and business metrics.
Shaping and executing a clear roadmap within your product area.
Building strong working relationships across business, technology and control functions.
Helping teams make better product decisions with better evidence.
Raising the quality of product thinking and execution within the broader product function
Required Behavioural Competencies
SFTx's 6 Leadership Principles:
Ownership Mindset – Looking for ways to do, instead of reasons not to. Being accountable for actions and decisions, owning both successes and mistakes, and learning and growing from each experience.
Growth Mindset – Always learning and improving, getting better each time. Embracing challenges and failures as opportunities for growth.
Customer Centricity – A deep understanding of the customer seen in everything you do. Being led by customers, their feedback and their behaviours.
Innovation (Jugaad) – Where some see impossible, seeing a way. Doing more with less, applying creativity to turn obstacles into opportunities, chance into change.
Velocity – Moving fast and fixing things. Working iteratively to deliver customer value without sacrificing long-term value for short-term results.
Inclusion – Seeking out and valuing different perspectives. Believing that when we change how we look at things, how things look for us also changes, making tomorrow not just different, but better.

Job Description:

This hire is created to relieve a growing compliance backlog and build a structured two-tier review system. Third-party firms prepare the returns and workpapers. It is a focused, high-trust role for someone who takes ownership of their output and does not need to be chased.
What's in it for you
Fully remote role based anywhere in South Africa, with no relocation required.
Work directly alongside a Managing Director with 18-plus years of US tax experience, gaining deep exposure to complex US fund structures.
Long-term engagement with a firm that intends to extend the contract indefinitely for the right person.
Paid in South African Rand through a local entity, removing currency and administrative friction.
20 days paid leave per year plus South African public holidays.
Equipment supplied or reimbursed, with all system access provided by the client.
Bonus discussed at offer stage.
Opportunity to work with AI tools including Claude, which the tax function already uses to automate entry-level tasks and routines.
Minimum Requirements
Ideally 5-7 years big four experience in the tax department
Prior experience supporting a US/UK/Irish asset management, financial services, real estate, hedge fund, or private equity tax practice.
Hands-on experience with Geneva or a comparable portfolio accounting system used by fund administrators.
Advanced Excel skills covering lookups, pivot tables, and large-dataset reconciliations with clearly built, traceable workpapers.
Exceptional reconciliation discipline where every number ties to a source and every adjustment is documented so a remote reviewer can follow it without a call.
Strong file management habits with consistent naming, versioning, and folder organisation.
Sharp eye for errors in work prepared by others.
Basic familiarity with Claude or similar AI tools and willingness to use them in daily work.
Professional written and spoken English for regular communication with US-based colleagues and third-party service providers.
Availability to overlap at least 5 hours daily with US Eastern Time, with extended overlap during peak periods in February to mid-April, late August to mid-September, and December.
Preferred requirements
Solid working knowledge of US partnership tax under Subchapter K, including allocations across large partnership structures and K-1 reporting.
Familiarity with US federal and state income tax forms, including the Form 1120 series and Form 1065.

Perform first level review of US federal and state corporate and partnership tax returns prepared by third-party accounting firms, flagging errors, inconsistencies, and open items.
Review Schedule K-1 deliverables for accuracy, consistency with fund allocations, and investor-level reporting.
Review estimated tax payment calculations and supporting schedules before payments are processed.
Perform tax and technical diligence on positions taken in third-party deliverables and raise uncertainties and potential risk areas early.
Reconcile taxable income workpapers to book income and portfolio accounting data, including allocations across large partnership structures.
Run and export reports from portfolio accounting systems such as Geneva to support tax workpapers and data requests.
Tie tax data back to source systems and document every adjustment with a clear, traceable paper trail.

Track deliverables to completion and escalate issues to the Managing Director, Tax.

Assist with process improvement and help extend the firm's use of AI tools within the tax function.

Job Description:
The Software Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining features across the full technology stack of our web platform. The role works across the React/TypeScript frontend, the Node.js/Express backend, and the PostgreSQL database layer, taking ownership of features from specification through to production deployment. Having grown beyond junior responsibilities, this role is expected to deliver production-ready features independently, contribute to technical decisions, handle deployments through our CI/CD pipeline, and integrate the platform with third-party services such as PayFast and transactional email providers.
Minimum requirements (Advantageous):
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
Experience
Minimum 8 years of professional software development experience.
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production web applications across the full stack.
Proven track record of shipping features from specification through to deployment.
Experience working in a Git-based collaborative development environment.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web development frameworks and tools, including React 18, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Framer Motion, and Leaflet.
Experience developing secure REST APIs, authentication, file uploads, transactional email, payment gateway integrations, and web application security best practices.
Understanding of REST API design principles and HTTP fundamentals.
Experience working with Git workflows, including feature branches, pull requests, and code reviews.
Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of features from concept through deployment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs effectively.
Collaborative mindset with experience participating in code reviews.
Self-motivated learner who keeps up to date with modern JavaScript, React, and Node.js development practices.
Reliable, accountable, and proactive in identifying and communicating blockers or risks early.
Duties and responsibilities include, but not limited to:
Translate product requirements, specifications, wireframes, and UI/UX designs into high-quality, production-ready frontend features.
Design, build, and maintain modern web applications using React and TypeScript.
Develop reusable, maintainable, and well-structured components that can be shared across features and applications.
Build responsive, accessible, and intuitive user interfaces that work consistently across modern desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
Convert UI/UX designs into accurate, polished interfaces while maintaining a consistent visual language across the product.
Implement appropriate application architecture, component composition, state management, routing, data fetching, caching, and form-management patterns.
Build complex forms and user workflows, including validation, conditional behaviour, multi-step processes, error handling, and user feedback.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services, including authentication, file uploads, payments, mapping, notifications, and other third-party services.
Work with REST APIs and other service interfaces, correctly handling authentication, pagination, validation errors, loading states, retries, failures, and asynchronous operations.
Implement secure authentication and authorisation flows in conjunction with backend services, ensuring appropriate handling of sessions, permissions, and protected application areas.
Apply frontend security best practices, including input handling, dependency management, secure browser storage practices, and protection against common web application vulnerabilities.
Design frontend solutions that accommodate changing requirements and future functionality without unnecessary complexity or excessive coupling.
Optimise applications for performance, including rendering efficiency, network usage, application loading time, asset optimisation, and perceived user responsiveness.
Implement appropriate client-side error handling and provide clear, useful feedback when operations fail.
Integrate file and image upload functionality, including validation, progress indication, previews, and error handling where required.
Implement interactive functionality such as maps, dashboards, data visualisations, search, filtering, dynamic forms, and other rich application experiences as required by the product.
Work closely with backend engineers to define and refine API contracts, data structures, authentication flows, and integration requirements.
Collaborate with product owners, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify practical technical solutions.
Participate in technical discussions and contribute to decisions regarding frontend architecture, application structure, reusable components, and engineering standards.
Write clean, readable, maintainable, and appropriately documented TypeScript and React code.
Write and maintain appropriate automated tests for components, application logic, integrations, and critical user journeys.
Diagnose and resolve defects reported by users, internal stakeholders, automated testing, or application monitoring.
Investigate and resolve browser-specific, device-specific, performance, usability, and accessibility issues.
Refactor and improve existing frontend code to reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and simplify future development.
Review code contributed by other developers and provide constructive feedback on correctness, maintainability, usability, security, and overall engineering quality.
Participate in source-control and code-review processes, including producing meaningful commits, pull requests, and supporting technical documentation.
Work effectively within automated build, testing, deployment, and CI/CD processes and assist in diagnosing issues affecting frontend releases.
Ensure frontend applications are configurable across local, development, staging, and production environments without embedding environment-specific configuration in application code.
Maintain awareness of modern React and TypeScript development practices and recommend improvements where they provide clear technical or product value.
Take ownership of assigned features from initial requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Contribute to the continued improvement of frontend engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and overall product quality.

Job Description:
IGrow Wealth Investments Group of Companies, proudly positioned as South Africa’s #1 Investment company, is searching for an ambitious and practical Senior AI Engineer to join our growing team in Durbanville, Cape Town.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is already a strong software engineer and understands how modern AI changes the way applications, workflows and business processes are designed and built.
You will design and build AI-first applications, agents and automated workflows that integrate with real business systems and data.
You will work across backend engineering, AI systems, data architecture and agentic automation, including building systems where AI agents can reason, use tools, access organisational knowledge, execute workflows and collaborate with people.
This is not primarily a data-science or prompt-engineering role. We are looking for a strong engineer who can build production software around modern AI.
You should be able to move between conventional software engineering and AI engineering rather than treating them as separate disciplines, understand the important principle of modern AI development.
"AI is not just a chatbot. It can be an active participant in software systems — finding information, using tools, making decisions within defined boundaries, coordinating workflows and working with humans to achieve outcomes. You will be expected to use AI extensively in your own engineering workflow. We want engineers who understand how to direct coding agents, review what they produce, test it, improve it and remain accountable for the resulting software."
You should be capable of taking a business requirement, helping shape the architecture, making sound technical decisions and delivering robust production software with limited supervision.

Advanced commercial Node.js experience.
Advanced TypeScript.
Strong backend software engineering and API design.
Strong PostgreSQL knowledge.
Solid understanding of relational data modelling and database performance.
Practical understanding of LLMs and modern AI application development.
Understanding of embeddings, semantic similarity and vector search.
Experience with or strong understanding of vector databases / pgvector.
Understanding of graph databases and knowledge graphs.
Understanding of agentic AI, tool calling and multi-step AI workflows.
Experience building integrations between different systems and APIs.
Comfortable with asynchronous processing, queues, scheduled jobs and event-driven architectures.
Strong Git and modern software-development practices.
Experience using AI coding agents/coding assistants as part of serious software development, not simply autocomplete.
AWS, Docker, ECS, S3, Redis, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mastra, MCP, RAG architectures, pgvector, Neo4j or other graph databases.
OAuth/OIDC, event-driven architectures, workflow engines and infrastructure as code.
Duties and responsibilities include, but not limited to:
Build production AI applications and agentic systems using Node.js and TypeScript.
Design backend services, APIs, integrations and event-driven systems.
Build agentic workflows where AI agents use tools, data and other agents to complete real business tasks.
Work with LLMs from multiple providers and understand model selection, context management and tool/function calling.
Design and implement AI memory and organisational knowledge systems.
Work extensively with PostgreSQL, including schema design, complex queries, performance and production data architecture.
Implement embeddings, semantic search, RAG and vector retrieval, including PostgreSQL/pgvector and dedicated vector databases where appropriate.
Understand and work with graph data and graph databases, including relationships between people, systems, processes, documents and organisational knowledge.
Build integrations with internal and external systems through APIs, MCP servers and other tool interfaces.
Design reliable long-running AI processes involving scheduled events, human approvals and asynchronous execution.
Use modern AI coding agents as a core part of the development process while maintaining engineering quality, testing and code review.
Help establish engineering patterns, reusable components and technical standards for AI-first development.

Company Details: The legal mandate and core business of the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE) are to manage, protect and conserve South Africas environment and natural resources. The mandate is informed by section 24 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996 (Act No. 108...read moreof 1996), which affords everyone the right to (a) an environment that is not harmful to their health or well-being; and (b) to have the environment protected for the benefit of present and future generations, through reasonable legislative and other measures. To give effect to this constitutional environmental right and the need for sound environmental management and sustainable development, the DFFE has over a period of time developed a comprehensive environmental management legislative/regulatory framework. This regulatory framework comprises acts of parliament (environmental laws), regulations, policies, norms and standards, and other regulatory tools that are aimed at promoting sound environmental management practices in order to protect and conserve the environment for the benefit of current and future generations. In addition to the development, implementation and ongoing review of a progressive regulatory framework for sound environmental management, other critical environmental management interventions by the DFFE include raising awareness on key environment issues and promoting a culture of environmental activism among ordinary citizens, building capacity within the sector, and establishing and strengthening national, regional and global partnerships to address common environmental challenges. The long-term vision of the DFFE is to have a prosperous and equitable society living in harmony with our natural resources, as outlined in our medium-term strategic plan. To support the achievement of this vision, the DFFE has identified five strategic goals, as follows: Environmental economic contribution optimised; Environmental/Ecological integrity safeguarded and enhanced; Social transformation within our communities; Global agenda influenced and obligations met; and A capable and efficient department. The DFFE is structured into nine budget programmes. Each programme pursues a set of identified strategic outcomes, which are aimed at achieving the commitments of the DFFE to the five-year strategic plan and to ultimately make successive progress towards the realisation of the long-term vision of the DFFE.

Job Description:
Job Purpose
To lead and manage SHERQ and sustainability operations, ensuring legal compliance, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement. The role is responsible for standardising systems and procedures, maintaining certifications (ISO 14001, ISO 45001, FSSC 22000), driving ESG strategy and supporting operational excellence through audits, stakeholder engagement, and data-driven decision-making. It also plays a key role in coaching teams, managing change, and aligning SHERQ and ESG practices with strategic business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Compliance & Risk Management:
Lead statutory inspections and ensure alignment with OHS, Environmental, R638, Marsh, AON, and other regulatory standards. Ensure legal registers are maintained and current across all sites. Review and improve fire safety and emergency preparedness procedures. Support sites in preparing for external risk audits (e.g., Marsh) and drive audit readiness programmes. Provide input on legal compliance and internal controls to mitigate operational and SHERQ risks. Monitor forthcoming and proposed legislative changes and drive their implementation. Ensure SHERQ and ESG compliance extends to VTM and office environments.
Audit & Certification:
Plan and oversee ISO, legal, and risk audits nationally (ISO 14001, ISO 45001, FSSC 22000). Monitor SHERQ audit performance and integrate audits for efficiency. Support sites in retaining existing certifications and attaining new ones. Conduct site audits to identify non-conformances and ensure effective closure. Evaluate management system effectiveness, verify corrective actions prevent recurrence, and implement shared audit learnings across regions and sites.
Standardisation & Continuous Improvement:
Drive standardisation of SHERQ and ESG systems, procedures, and documentation across all regions. Lead Centre of Excellence initiatives to embed consistent practices and toolkits. Monitor SHERQ operational trends and implement forward-thinking improvements. Drive SHERQ and ESG projects (e.g., site mergers, upgrades, software implementation). Benchmark best practices and define criteria and methods to assess the effectiveness of operational processes and controls.
ESG strategy and Reporting:
Support the execution of Vector’s ESG strategy, including project tracking and reporting. Develop, communicate and monitor SHERQ and ESG performance indicators, and escalate adverse trends and concerns to the SHERQ Executive. Identify opportunities and threats and involve management in implementing response plans.
Stakeholder Engagement & Support:
Engage with customers, principals, and service providers to resolve complaints, recalls, and investigations. Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Risk, PBCS, VTM, and SHERQ teams to meet strategic goals. Advise and support teams on new and existing SHERQ legislation and standards. Attend meetings and represent SHERQ in customer and principal engagements.
Training & Capability Building:
Coach and mentor SHERQ teams in delivering ESG and SHERQ support. Facilitate training on statutory compliance, safety, food safety, and environmental standards. Promote a culture of safety, sustainability, and accountability across the network.
Systems & Documentation:
Ensure documentation systems are current, practical, and user-friendly. Maintain internal and external audit schedules. Ensure timely and complete submission of all required reports. Validate report accuracy and ensure identified improvement opportunities are addressed.

Internal
High degree of interaction for the purpose of strategy, compliance, training and collaboration.
Exrernal
Moderate to high degree of interaction for the purpose of issue resolution, audits relationship management
Auditors
High degree of interaction for the purpose of compliance, certification and inspections.

In-depth knowledge of supply chain operations, warehousing, and customer requirements. Lead auditor experience across ISO, food safety, environmental, health & safety, and ESG domains.
Valid Code 8 drivers' licence

Ability to interpret and apply legal requirements across multiple sites. Risk assessment and mitigation planning. Fire safety and emergency preparedness expertise.
Audit & Certification Management: ISO standards expertise (ISO 14001, ISO 45001, FSSC 22000). Internal and external audit planning and execution.Non-conformance identification and corrective action management. Certification maintenance and improvement.

Executive, Exco, Board subcommittee and stakeholder packs are accurate, complete, decision-ready and submitted on time.

Job Description:
About the role
The Head of Creditors oversees the effective management of the business's creditor function, ensuring supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations and related financial information are accurate, complete and managed on time. You will make sure suppliers are paid accurately and within agreed terms, maintain strong supplier relationships, support effective cash flow management and prevent supplier accounts being placed on hold, while providing accurate and timely creditor information for financial reporting, cash flow forecasting and informed decision-making. You will report to the Finance Executive.
What you'll do:
Make sure supplier accounts are accurately reconciled and paid on time by reviewing the team's reconciliations and completing supplier reconciliations yourself where required, so payment discrepancies are minimised and major suppliers never place the business on hold
Maintain effective supplier relationships and resolve reconciliation issues promptly, engaging with suppliers as required so outstanding queries never disrupt business operations
Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed accurately and on time, reviewing invoice capturing and capturing monthly expenses when required
Maintain accurate payment schedules and the accounts payable age analysis, so information is always available for cash flow forecasting, with regular checks and monthly notes to the business
Run effective supplier account administration and compliance: create new supplier accounts, confirm supplier banking details in line with company procedures, and help collect supplier invoices and statements at month end
What you'll bring:
Matric with a pass in Mathematics
National Diploma, BTech or BCom in Accounting
At least 5 years' Accounts Payable management experience, with a sound understanding of supplier reconciliations, invoice processing, payments and age analysis
Experience managing staff or team members, and the ability to lead and review a team's work
Strong attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing reconciliations, invoices, payment schedules and supplier banking details
A good understanding of financial controls and company procedures, particularly around supplier banking details and payments
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing priorities
Strong communication and interpersonal skills for engaging with suppliers and internal stakeholders
Good computer literacy, particularly Excel and Outlook
Experience in the hospitality industry preferred

Position Purpose
The Helicopter Night Captain is the Commander of the aircraft for both Day and Night operations and takes ultimate responsibility for the safety and management of the flight crew and passengers on board the aircraft as per TNPA procedures as well as the SACAA Civil Aviation Regulations and Technical Standards, including but not limited to, Parts 91.02.7 and 91.02.8.
Position Outputs
Due to the increased risk levels associated with operating at night, the Helicopter Night Captain must display advanced skill levels regarding Flying ability and judgemental capabilities.Marine pilot transfers at night can be extremely hazardous and the Night Captain must possess the ability to safey control all situations as they develop.
Ability by Night to execute a safe hoist with minimal buffer margins, without external visual references and horizon to assist with maintaining the stability of the helicopter, to move the helicopter’s main and tail rotor disc to within danger close proximity of obstacles, on moving vessels with constantly changing references, all the while constantly monitoring for unforseen risk and hazards, monitoring aircraft instruments, maintaining the height, position and stability of the helicopter over the selected point, in adverse and constantly changing sea conditions, wind and swell, whilst listening to and receiving commands for movement of the helicopter from the hoist operator during daylight, lowlight, night time conditions, marginal weather and high stress environment. Failure to carry out any of the above safely every time would result in catastophic failiure, inicident or accident with imminent loss of life and equipment.
Conduct day and night helicopter flights under all-weather conditions in accordance with TNPA standard operating procedures and aeronautical publications.

Job Description:
The Southern Consumer 4P Manager serves as Lenovo's local Product Ambassador for the Consumer portfolio across Southern Africa, acting as the bridge between the regional Consumer Business Unit and the local sales organization. This role drives alignment across product strategy, pricing, portfolio direction, promotions, forecasting, and business priorities, while balancing regional objectives with local market opportunities and commercial realities. The ideal candidate combines strong product and category management expertise with commercial and financial acumen, strategic thinking, and exceptional stakeholder management skills. Success in this role requires the ability to influence and drive execution across multiple stakeholders without direct authority, while operating independently with limited day-to-day supervision.
What You Will Do:
Co-own Consumer business performance across Southern Africa, including revenue, profitability, market share, and inventory health.
Represent the MEA Consumer Business Unit locally and translate regional strategy into effective territory execution.
Influence sales teams, distributors, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive business priorities and product strategies.
Lead business planning, forecasting, portfolio management, and regular performance reviews for the Southern market.
Identify growth opportunities, competitive risks, performance gaps, and corrective actions to achieve business objectives.
Support product launches, go-to-market execution, promotions, and demand generation activities across the territory.
Maintain a strong operating cadence with sales teams on inventory management, sell-out plans, promotional activities, and products in transit.
Use dashboards, business analytics, and data-driven reviews to identify gaps, track progress, and drive accountability through regular business checks.
Build strong relationships with country leadership, sales teams, distributors, and key partners while maintaining commercial discipline and accountability.
Operate independently as the primary Consumer 4P leader for the Southern market, driving execution with limited day-to-day supervision.
What We Look For:
Bachelor's degree required; MBA is preferred.
5–7+ years of experience in product management, category management, consumer business management, portfolio management, or go-to-market management.
Demonstrated experience with P&L ownership and strong financial and commercial acumen.
Experience managing product portfolios within PCs, consumer electronics, tablets, mobility, technology hardware, or related industries.
Strong knowledge of the Southern African market, particularly South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zimbabwe, and Zambia, and its retail and channel ecosystem.
Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, portfolio strategy, product launches, category strategy, market analysis, and GTM planning.
Proven ability to influence without authority, challenge stakeholders constructively, and drive execution across cross-functional teams.
Strong executive presence, negotiation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills.
Strong analytical and business planning capabilities, including forecasting, financial modelling, inventory management, revenue management, and market share analysis.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, as well as business analytics and reporting tools.
Strong AI literacy and the ability to use AI tools effectively to improve business analysis, planning, and execution.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Job Description
The Capital and Liquidity Management Team, within Treasury and Financial Markets, plays a strategic role in managing the Group’s capital and liquidity position to support shareholder value creation and financial resilience. This high-performing, analytically-focused team partners with senior stakeholders across Finance, Risk, and Actuarial to optimise capital management and deployment, capital and liquidity planning, and funding strategies across Old Mutual Limited.
The role offers exposure to all aspects of corporate treasury and capital management, including surplus capital forecasting and deployment, liquidity and solvency modelling, managing financial leverage, credit rating agency management, regulatory capital reporting and balance sheet optimisation projects across the group and OM Bank. It is well suited to an individual who thrives in a dynamic environment, combining strategic insight with technical depth.
The position reports to the Senior Group Treasury Manager.
Key Result Areas
Capital and Liquidity Management
Support the design, maintenance, and execution of Group capital and liquidity management frameworks across Group entities and holding companies.
Contribute to capital forecasting, dividend capacity analysis, and capital deployment assessments.
Assist with capital and liquidity planning, stress testing, and scenario analysis in line with internal risk appetite and regulatory constraints.
Analyse capital, solvency, and liquidity trends, highlighting emerging risks and optimisation opportunities.
Support the preparation of inputs into Group Capital and Funding Plans.
Treasury Operations and Funding
Manage intragroup funding requirements and ensure efficient liquidity allocation across entities.
Support the Group’s Debt Capital Markets programme, including issuance, refinancing, and investor engagement.
Oversee dividend execution and explore optimisation opportunities across insurance subsidiaries and the Group.
Manage cash and treasury share positions, including share purchases for employee schemes and monitoring of the share buyback programme.
Maintain appropriate governance and controls across treasury operations and cash flow management.
Strategic Projects, Balance Sheet Optimisation & Governance
Participate in and support balance sheet optimisation initiatives across Group businesses, including capital structure reviews, funding efficiency projects, and evaluation of corporate actions (e.g. dividends, capital injections, restructuring) from a capital and liquidity perspective.
Provide analytical input into investment business cases and strategic initiatives with balance sheet implications, identifying and assessing opportunities to enhance capital efficiency and liquidity resilience.
Partner with key stakeholders across Group Finance, Risk, and Actuarial to support capital strategy and policy execution.
Coordinate and support the external credit rating process, ensuring accurate, timely, and effective communication of the Group’s financial position.
Engage with auditors, regulators, and other external stakeholders on capital, liquidity, and debt-related matters.
Participate in and support governance forums, including preparation of analysis and reporting to relevant management and Board committees.
Financial Modelling and Insight
Develop and maintain financial, solvency and liquidity models to forecast solvency, funding, and dividend capacity.
Perform scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess capital adequacy and liquidity under various market conditions.
Present actionable insights to senior management to inform capital and funding decisions.
Governance, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
Prepare and present high-quality Treasury and Capital reports for the Board, Exco, and subcommittees.
Ensure adherence to governance frameworks, internal policies, and external regulations.
Identify opportunities to automate and streamline Treasury reporting and liquidity processes.
Contribute to ongoing initiatives focused on capital and liquidity optimisation across the Group.
Qualifications and Experience Required
Relevant postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, Banking, or Actuarial Science.
Additional professional qualification (e.g., CA(SA), FASSA, CFA) is advantageous.
Minimum 6 years’ experience in balance sheet management, treasury, or capital management within insurance or financial services.
Strong technical knowledge of solvency, capital, and liquidity frameworks.
Proficient with financial services regulations, with thorough knowledge of Prudential Standards for Insurers and Insurance Groups and Basel being advantageous.
Proven experience in surplus capital reporting, liquidity management, funding operations, and debt programme execution.
Experience with credit rating agency management and capital market transactions.
Advanced analytical and financial modelling capability, with sound business judgment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, able to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
Pragmatic, commercially astute, and solutions-focused with attention to detail.
